payload.title: Baseline and integrate typed multi-timescale FRANK reward-state successor
payload.work_clay: Reconstruct exact historical NAcc callers/state/version semantics; benchmark historical NAcc; compare scalar, historical, typed, typed+multitimescale and simpler outcome-credit+homeostasis successors; integrate the winning baseline-gated reward update between causal_credit and slow plasticity/reentry in H2/H3.
payload.reason_clay: Current loop contract requires slow reward/personality/homeostasis updates, while G9 main cycle currently jumps causal_credit->reentry. Fresh 2024/2025 evidence makes one homogeneous scalar RPE a weak default. Local deterministic successor probe passed 9/9 research invariants but is not runtime evidence.
payload.completion_clay: Complete only with H1 historical baseline/caller coverage, matched long-horizon replay, scalar-vs-typed-vs-simpler comparisons, lesion/rescue, self-reward poisoning controls, shuffled/broken-credit controls, OOD reversal, restart/recovery, target-Ubuntu resource receipts, H2 differential semantics and explicit promotion/rejection receipt.
evidence_need: matched replay and long-horizon factorial lesions
scalar vs typed vs typed+multitimescale vs simpler baseline
self-reward poisoning and safety/resource conflict controls
payload.executor_policy: Research Entity owns implementation/effect. Frank self-observation may propose only. Revalidate latest work revision and baseline before any Harness effect.
required_capabilities: ClayCode compiler when BASE gate permits
invalidators: historical NAcc caller archaeology shows materially different semantics
simpler outcome-credit+homeostasis baseline dominates typed candidate
new evidence invalidates current reward representation assumptions
